title: Flux render OOMs at SamplerCustomAdvanced when a second pipeline's model is cached in VRAM
evidence: torch.OutOfMemoryError: Allocation on device 0 would exceed allowed memory (out of memory) at node 84 SamplerCustomAdvanced; ComfyUI logs '[ERROR] Got an OOM, unloading all loaded models'. Host RAM was NOT the constraint this time (MemoryMax=infinity, 86 GiB free, telemetry oom_kill_events=0, mem_peak 71.7 GiB). VRAM was 22.8/24 GiB. The same workflow SUCCEEDED at 96GiB-capped config when no second model family was resident (gen-1789830366 -> photos#339 -> scheduling_posts#333). Correlated with the unblocked JobSubmitterWorker submitting a sarah-carnival-v1 (pony/SDXL CRPv18_PM40) job concurrently with turbo-one-step-clean (flux) work; the comfy log shows SDXLClipModel and FluxClipModel both being loaded in the same window.

notes.note: Hypotheses to test in order: (1) serialize model families so flux and pony are never cached simultaneously; (2) stale sarah-carnival-v1 work from the deprecated ELO/image_candidate era should be expired rather than submitted at all - it has produced nothing since 2026-05-28; (3) if contention is ruled out, the flux workflow is genuinely at/over the 24 GiB edge and needs a VRAM budget change (lower resolution, or ComfyUI --lowvram since host RAM is now abundant). Do NOT add launch flags without evidence: the known-good launch is `main.py --listen 0.0.0.0`.

ROOT CAUSE FIXED in repo (2026-09-19). (1) SelectNextJob picked every run that was not 'completed' (where.not(status: 'completed')), so 374 FAILED runs from the deprecated pipelines (sarah-carnival-v1 pony/SDXL, turbo-one-step) stayed workable forever and JobSubmitterWorker re-rendered them: jobs 7543/7544 (pipe19 pony) and 7545/7547 (pipe20) were dispatched 15:40-15:57Z today while the growth harness rendered flux; the ComfyUI log shows SDXLClipModel and FluxClipModel_ staging in alternating windows and job 7541 OOM'd at SamplerCustomAdvanced. Verified: old workable set = 384 runs (374 failed + 110 deprecated-pipeline), new = 0. Fix: work only status pending/running, and skip runs tagged variables['sync_producer']. (2) Growth::ContentGenerator creates a run 'pending' and submits its own job synchronously, so the async submitter queued a DUPLICATE render for the same run (run457/461 had 2 jobs each) - it now tags the run sync_producer and writes a terminal status on every exit path. (3) SubmitJob now refuses to dispatch for a terminal run (dispatch-boundary invariant, spec-covered). (4) New probe guard render-dispatched-for-terminal-run verified to fire on a synthetic regression (count 1) and 0 on live data. (5) Reconciled the 10 orphaned pending runs to completed/failed. Evidence: SelectNextJob on live data -> mode=no_work; SubmitJob on a failed run -> success=false, 0 ComfyuiJob rows created; 174 rspec examples in packs/{comfyui,job_orchestration,pipeline} pass.

LIVE-VERIFICATION UPDATE (16:56Z): the running Sidekiq worker now executes the fixed selector - its pid restarted at 16:54:39Z and every JobSubmitterWorker tick since logs 'SelectNextJob: No active runs need work' (previously it dispatched a dead-run render every few minutes; last such dispatch was job 7552 at 16:36:44Z). Zero new ComfyuiJob rows since 16:39Z, in_flight=0, and no render was dispatched for any of the 374 failed runs. Note: the worker had the old selector in memory until that restart; a stale worker process is the one way this fix can look applied but stay inert.
